Business.description: What the major business and general-news outlets are leading with.
Business.overview: Business coverage is dominated by the start of Wall Street's Q3 earnings season, with major banks posting mixed results against a backdrop of a deepening chip-stock selloff tied to AI investment fears. Geopolitical risk is also weighing heavily, from fallout over Trump's Russian diesel deal and Kimberly Guilfoyle's ouster as ambassador to Greece, to new worries about French banks amid sovereign bond stress and riots.

stories.headline: Wall Street banks post mixed Q3 results as rates and AI concerns loom
stories.summary: JPMorgan posted surprisingly spotty results as higher interest rates ate into profits, while Goldman Sachs beat expectations on a surge in equities trading revenue.

stories.headline: Chip stocks tumble further as AI spending fears mount
stories.summary: A warning from Broadcom's CEO about a 'casino' mentality in AI investing helped send Samsung and SK Hynix sharply lower and drag down the Kospi, as the chipmaker selloff extended into a second day.

stories.headline: White House pushes out Kimberly Guilfoyle as Greece ambassador
stories.summary: Trump's team asked Guilfoyle to resign after reports she accepted improper gifts and used political connections for financial favors, which she has denied.

stories.headline: Trump's Russian diesel deal draws bipartisan fire in Congress
stories.summary: Moderate Republicans joined Democrats in criticizing Trump's agreement with Putin to temporarily roll back sanctions and release Russian diesel to the global market amid a fuel price spike.

stories.headline: Analysts warn widening French riots could spark bank deposit flight
stories.summary: Macquarie analysts cautioned that rising French government bond yields combined with ongoing riots could trigger foreign depositors to pull money from French banks, drawing comparisons to the 2023 Silicon Valley Bank collapse.

stories.headline: Hackers trigger fires and food spoilage in French supermarket cyberattack
stories.summary: A cyberattack on refrigeration systems at hundreds of French supermarkets sent fridge temperatures as high as 80°C, melting equipment and destroying food, raising alarm over food-supply security.

stories.headline: Rising bond yields reflect growing worries over government debt levels
stories.summary: Some analysts say investors are demanding a higher 'term premium' to hold government debt as borrowing costs climb to multidecade highs, reflecting deepening concern about deficits.

Business.gaps: The Information and Puck's news feed focused mainly on media/Hollywood/politics topics rather than core business stories in this window, so little directly relevant business content was found from them beyond general midterm and media-industry coverage.

Energy.overview: Energy and climate outlets are converging on the U.S. permitting-reform fight in Congress, the fallout from rising power prices tied to data-center demand, and a wave of utility/grid consolidation and regulatory decisions (Dominion-NextEra, FERC-PJM). Geopolitics also intrudes, with a Trump-announced Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire and a Kazakhstan uranium deal favoring China drawing notice.

stories.headline: Huffman pushes back on Senate's bipartisan permitting deal
stories.summary: Rep. Jared Huffman, the top Democrat on the House Natural Resources Committee, is raising objections to the Senate's energy permitting bill, warning that developers could get paid off rather than actually approved when projects are blocked.

stories.headline: Trump declares an 'energy ceasefire' in the Russia-Ukraine war
stories.summary: The U.S. president announced an immediate halt to energy-related attacks between Russia and Ukraine, though it remains unclear whether this truce will hold any longer than a prior one he claimed to have brokered.

stories.headline: TotalEnergies buys up U.S. solar after axing its offshore wind projects
stories.summary: Despite taking over $1 billion from the Trump administration to cancel its offshore wind projects, TotalEnergies' joint venture with KKR is adding 700 megawatts of solar in Texas and Ohio in a $1.2 billion deal.

stories.headline: Dominion-NextEra merger hearing zeroes in on rates and data centers
stories.summary: A local hearing on the proposed Dominion-NextEra merger focused on how the deal would affect customer rates and data-center growth in Virginia.

stories.headline: FERC rejects most of PJM's plan to curtail large data-center loads
stories.summary: Federal regulators found that PJM's proposal to curtail large loads lacking matching new generation intrudes on state jurisdiction and appears discriminatory.

stories.headline: How utilities lost their grip on Washington
stories.summary: A new analysis examines how utilities have seen their political influence erode in Washington amid the data-center power boom and shifting policy fights.

stories.headline: New coalition launches to help small U.S. towns lead on clean energy
stories.summary: A newly announced group aims to help small towns, which are often overlooked in clean-energy policy, gain more collective influence by banding together.

Energy.gaps: Argus Media could not be searched this session, so no recent coverage is reported for it. E&E News' own site stopped publishing new content after August 31 (it has folded into POLITICO Pro), so no fresh items could be verified beyond that transition. Reuters, FT, WSJ, NYT, and The Economist block web search and no feed items were provided for them, so their current coverage could not be assessed.
